pending_part_2.voiceover_script: In Part 1, we explored the massive underground city of Mount Weather, but declassified memos reveal a far more terrifying reality. Mount Weather does not merely house human survivors. It operates an entirely separate, unelected shadow bureaucracy known as the Federal Relocation Arc, complete with duplicate government agencies authorized to suspend constitutional law during national crises. When investigators examined budget appropriations, they uncovered millions in untraceable funds directed into deep subterranean excavation projects that continue expanding to this day. Even more disturbing, local residents frequently report high-voltage electromagnetic surges and unmarked military convoys vanishing directly into the mountain face under the dead of night. What are they preparing for beneath the stone?
